summary: Iteration 148: Multi-day/Recurring Posts Feature - All tests passed (9/9 backend, 100% frontend). Recurring posts creation with weekly/daily/biweekly/monthly frequencies working correctly. Bulk update endpoint working. Calendar views (day/week/month) display recurring posts with RefreshCw icon badge.

issues: Minor: Missing aria-describedby for DialogContent (accessibility warning in console)

critical_code_review_comments: POST /api/demand-studio/social/posts/recurring correctly creates multiple posts with shared recurrence_id
Weekly frequency with days_of_week=[1] (Tuesday) creates posts on consecutive Tuesdays
Each post has recurrence_id, recurrence_index, recurrence_total, recurrence_frequency fields
PUT /api/demand-studio/social/posts/recurring/{recurrence_id}/bulk-update updates all unposted posts (skips status='posted')
Daily frequency creates consecutive daily posts
Monthly frequency uses python-dateutil relativedelta for accurate month calculations
Biweekly frequency creates posts every 2 weeks
Frontend Recurring button visible with data-testid='new-recurring-button'
Calendar shows recurring posts with RefreshCw icon badge (line 1301 in SocialMediaPage.js)
